# INTENT

## User Request

Give the app owner a private client table and access to every menu, while clients can only view and edit their own menus. Let the owner create a menu, invite a client by email, transfer the menu to that account, manage monthly or annual billing dates, and upload invoice files that the client can view from account settings.

## Requested Outcome

The admin-entitled owner can manage clients, all menus, assignments, billing dates, and invoices. Clients can manage their assigned menus and read their own account and invoice information.

## Constraints

- Owner access is granted only by the existing admin entitlement.
- Clients may own multiple menus.
- Billing is managed manually by the owner, not through Polar.
- Invoice files must remain private.
- Clients cannot edit billing data.

## Open Questions

None. The implementation plan was approved by the user.
